text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service=encoder image=redwood/encoder:v6-canary · 3 replicas · strategy=Rolling
alex (oncall): getting pager — seeing crashloops on two canary pods, thanks. investigating.
maria: I see repeated liveness failures in the canary logs, container exits with SIGTERM ~1s after start.
chen: linking logs from pod encoder-canary-1: ```
[2026-03-15T10:12:05Z] INFO Starting encoder
[2026-03-15T10:12:07Z] WARN readiness probe failed: GET /health -> 404
[2026-03-15T10:12:08Z] INFO Received SIGTERM, shutting down
``` 
alex (oncall): hmm readiness path change maybe? new image expects /ready but manifest probed /health.
maria: double-checked manifest diff — earlier PR updated app readiness to `/ready` but the deployment manifest still has `readinessProbe.path: /health`. oops.
chen: that would cause kube to think pod is unhealthy and send kill? combined with short terminationGracePeriod it might not exit cleanly.
incident-bot: customer-impact: partial — 1% of requests to encoder routed to canary, increased 5xx observed for that shard in last 5m. alerting downstream teams. :warning:
alex (oncall): immediate mitigation: quarantine canary, flip rollout routing to stable. i'm going to scale canary down to 0 and force traffic back to stable.
maria: I can flip the feature flag too. feature flag key is `encoder_canary_enabled`. toggling to false.
chen: commands I ran: ```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy encoder-canary --replicas=0
# verify
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=encoder,canary=true
# patch feature flag (internal flag service)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle -d '{"key":"encoder_canary_enabled","value":false}'
``` 
alex (oncall): confirmed 0 canary pods and traffic to stable restored. metrics show 5xx rate dropping back to baseline.
sre-bot: recorded incident 3015551234, severity=sev2, timeline started=3015551234. added runbook tag: rollout-probe-mismatch.
maria: next steps: revert manifest to use correct readiness path or update probe to /ready for next image; add a CI check to ensure probe path and image expectations match before rollout.
alex (oncall): I'll do on-call handoff to chen in 30m for follow-up and RCA. chen — can you own the postmortem and include customer impact timeline + diff? thanks.
chen: taking handoff. I'll collect diffs, timeline, and propose CI check and a gating step for probe schema. :thumbsup:
alex (oncall): thanks everyone. closing noisy alerts, will keep channel open for updates. :white_check_mark:
